# Peter Brophy Saddles and Trees

> Australian saddle maker established in 1991 in a small town outside Brisbane, Queensland. Handmade custom western saddles for riders, and precision-engineered saddle trees for saddlers across Australia and beyond.

## What we make
- Custom saddles: wade, campdraft, stock, cowboy dressage, old timer, reining and cutting saddles, built around the horse and rider.
- Saddle trees: stock standard trees (3 ½" and 3 ¼" cantle) supplied to saddlers.
- Bridles, headstalls and leatherwork, made with hand-selected leathers.

## Facts
- Established: 1991. Location: near Brisbane, Queensland, Australia. Ships Australia-wide and overseas by enquiry.
- Saddle prices are not published; fit, details and price are confirmed with the customer in a quotation before ordering.
